entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Can't debug over a JS interop module call in .NET 10 rc2 in VS2026: [MONO] * Assertion: should not be reached at /__w/1/s/src/runtime/src/mono/mono/metadata/class-accessors.c:93 #120883
  • Source Generator generated wrong code for regex `(?<=(abc)+?123)a` in .NET10 #120882
  • ArrayBufferWriter throws an ArgumentException with the message 'sizeHint' #120878
  • Size of EXE has been doubled after update of System.Text.Encoding.CodePages from 9.0.8 to 9.0.9 #120875
  • Regex `.IsMatch` returns the wrong result compared with `Matches`. #120873

Closed

  • Unresolvable(?) breaking change with System.Linq.Async in net10.0 #119718
  • Regex engine throws index out of range #114626
    Future
  • Result of Regex.Match("wtfb",@"(.)()+?b") is not same as new Regex(@"(.)()+?b",RegexOptions.Compiled).Match("wtfb") #111051
    Future
  • Investigate OutOfMemory Exception happening woth Regex.Match for some patterns in the interpreted engine. #63385
    Future
  • IndexOutOfRangeException in RegexInterpreter caused by not always resizing its stack appropriately #58786
    Future
  • Regex pattern returns infinite matches #43314
    Future
  • `UriKind.Absolute` fails `"localhost:8080"` test case #120874
  • jitrollingbuild failing with Python package issues #120867
    11.0.0
  • Regex parser is not reducing some loops which causes some patterns to not be able to avoid catastrophic backtracking #73208
    Future
  • Regex throw an exception `Specified argument was out of the range of valid values.` in compiled mode #119444
    Future
  • Problem with Vulkan and Dotnet #120828

PullRequests

Created

  • Add EventPipe EventSource serialization testing #120887
    area-System.Diagnostics.Tracing
  • Optimize fixed-length regex patterns with both leading and trailing anchors #120886
    area-System.Text.RegularExpressions
  • Add index to OrderedDictionary debugger display #120885
    area-System.Collections
  • Fix regex source generator emitting invalid code for lazy loops inside lookarounds #120884
    area-System.Text.RegularExpressions
  • Fix ArgumentException parameter name in ArrayBufferWriter #120880
    area-System.Runtime
  • [clr-interp] Fix additional iteration in Copy_Ref implementation on arm64 #120879
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • Replace signed comparisons with unsigned comparisons in bounds checking `ImmutableArray<T>.Builder` #120877
    area-System.Collections, community-contribution
  • Extend the "skip-test" optimization to all instructions that modify the #120876
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution

Merged

  • Fix IndexOutOfRangeException to use default message instead of "index" #120881
    area-Extensions-Logging, 11.0.0
  • Fix longstanding regex interpreter bug around lazy loops with empty matches #120872
    area-System.Text.RegularExpressions
  • bump azure.storage.blob and azure.identity versions #120868
    needs-area-label

Updated

  • Add debug information for runtime async methods #120303
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Implement getAsyncInfo in ILCompiler #120859
    area-crossgen2-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Add centralized Helix platform alias definitions files #120817
    area-Infrastructure
  • Support function pointer types in ``System.Reflection.Emit`` #119935
    area-System.Reflection.Emit, community-contribution
  • [browser] build browserhost in host.native subset #120298
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • Stop spilling ldvirtftn #120866
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Add IReadOnlySet support to System.Text.Json #120306
    area-System.Text.Json, community-contribution
  • Add flags for overflow on clang. #120775
    area-VM-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Improve `FrozenDictionary.ToFrozenDictionary` for Dictionary sources with different comparers #120795
    area-System.Collections, community-contribution
